items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Maude deForrest went to Europe with Josephine Baker... Josephine Baker was in -- she sat in our theater at the Palace -- no, the Theater am Zoo, it was. And she listened to our show and all.

ctx.x: Do you remember, what tunes were in the Plantation revue. And who else was with it. Who was with the show.

Well, we had a quartet of youngsters around there. We had Maude deForrest. Later, Maude deForrest went to Europe with Josephine Baker. She had been chosen by Josephine Baker bein' the first strip teaser. Maude deForrest was a very good blues singer. Because she had a heavy voice. And everybody thought you had to have a heavy voice to sing the blues in those days. The heavier your voice was, the better they thought you could sing the blues. As if that had anything to do with it anyway.
